text:
kevin: Quick PSA 18th Ave had a surprise splash from a delivery truck at 08:12, soaked my commute bag. Anyone else hit by random tidal waves this AM?

aisha: Yep  280 north had a slow spill after the rain, added ~15m. Also someone left a folding umbrella at Mission reception yesterday  is that ours?

tam: I grabbed the umbrella bin last week and labeled the handles "Redwood". Left a spare blue collapsible this morning. If you want I can drop it by the 12:30 lunch run.

mike: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/oh-no-rain-3o6ZtaO9BZHcOjmErS (mood)

kevin: @tam could you leave one near the bike rack? My bag is soggy and Id rather not sit on a wet chair in the standup.

devops-bot: Reminder: oncall handoff at 09:00. unrelated to puddles but logging here in case someone needs a quick ping. :gear:

aisha: Also FYI Muni tweeted a minor disruption on the 22 line at 07:50 due to signal checks. Expect 8-12m delays through SoMa.

ella: Quick poll  if your commute gets soaked, what's your move? react with emoji: :umbrella: borrow from office, :sneaker: bring a spare, :tshirt: dry at desk, :bus: switch to transit

mike: :umbrella:

tam: :sneaker:

kevin: :tshirt: (desk dryer FTW)

aisha: @kevin if you need a towel or spare dry socks I left a pair in the reception drawer labelled "commute extras".

ella: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/saving-umbrella-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40 (mood)

kevin: You folks rock. If anyone's heading toward 7th & Mission later and can grab my soggy charger from my desk, DM me  Ill owe you coffee.

tam: I can swing by after lunch. Stay dry everyone!
